checks.detail: Separate task-owned tree; seven focused test targets built successfully after all source edits.
7/7. Public complete-blob/hunk classifier plus appearance core/contrast/exchange and offscreen Qt profile/settings/display.
Qt-free tree; appearance policy/contrast/exchange and application appearance host targets built successfully.

7/7, 154.27 seconds. Started before product commit against its working candidate. Only subsequent C++ enum formatting, assertion-message/comment refinements and extra existing-contract assertions followed; affected exact-candidate runtime checks were rebuilt/rerun. Core/architecture gate implementation and build graph relevant to this slice were unchanged.
4/4 exact committed candidate. Includes host counting-classifier proof that theme, palette, mode and typography changes retain spans and yield a cache hit without another classification.
67 tests; malformed-fixture diagnostics are expected negative cases.

acceptance.AC1: Public C++ classifier gives nested GCT/Network, simple lowercase namespace, alias names and using-namespace chains independent namespace roles.
acceptance.AC2: All Node/ID/Player/DNA declarations and scoped/unscoped enum fixtures pass. Call/parenthesis/template/braced/lambda/attribute initializers preserve enumerator boundaries, including NEXT after a shadowing lambda; AFTER_ENUM retains macro role.
acceptance.AC3: Hunk beginning after enum opener equals exactly the selected whole-blob spans. Raw strings, comments, directives and continued directives provide no structural facts.
acceptance.AC4: Existing full contract includes C, Windows Resource, type/function/macro, directive operands, predefined macros, plain text and packaged-only grammar policy. Genuine ENUM_VALUE in initializers and GCT_ASSERT stay macros.
acceptance.AC5: C++ revision 6 refuses revision-5 requests; C/resource revision 5 stays unchanged. Public key has no theme, and host cache reuse test passes after every appearance domain changes.
acceptance.AC6: Qualified scope/member facts recognize matching declarations and namespace reopening. Negative controls deny unrelated same-named members, unknown externals, local/parameter shadows, aliases, duplicate/conflicting declarations, object-qualified paths and unresolved template paths. Unknown uppercase terminals receive no enum or macro role.

negative_controls: Other::Reason::DNA has a declared Reason but no matching member; no enum/macro role.
Local and parameter shadows suppress outer Reason::ID recognition.
Unknown ExternalReason::ID remains neutral; old revision-5 C++ key is refused.
Cancelled/over-limit public requests publish no partial spans.
failure_dispositions: Initial negative assertion selected an earlier same-spelled declaration on its line; fixture split so assertion names intended use, then passed.
Initial new helper tidy failure exposed a missing namespace_alias enumerator and duplicate branch; corrected and final six production units pass tidy.
Initial exchange assertion omitted the two new optional roles; expected count and compatibility assertions corrected, then passed.

Initial Light namespace default #216F85 missed three tinted-background contrast pairs (4.44,4.13,4.23 against 4.50). Changed only new namespace default to #1B5E70; final all-variant profile contrast passes all 374 required pairs.
Initial format invocation used unsupported --paths; rerun with supported positional paths. Final clang-format 22.1.8 check passes.
self_review: One bounded simplification/correctness pass retained private adapter ownership, grammar protection, noncopied name views, conservative scope facts, cancellation and all-or-nothing output; no known critical M1 defect remains.
pending: RFC AC06 composed offscreen declaration/use categories in both panes across light/dark with neighboring real macro; existing all-variant contrast passing evidence can be reused while defaults stay unchanged.
RFC AC08 independent per-variant editing, restart, old/new theme import/export, preservation of existing custom values and stored flags.
Final current-count and architecture documentation reconciliation plus scoped final diff against RFC_BASE_SHA and RFC/index closeout.
limits: Best-effort lexical facts from admitted UTF-8 blob only (8 MiB admission ceiling); no compiler, includes, repository-wide symbols or alias target resolution.
No installed/release/native/human acceptance claim; no human review requirement has been inferred for this RFC.
